# TOFU BOX
自己日常用的一组 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件，都在这个仓库里，从 npm 安装（源码在 GitHub）。
中文 · English
## 中文
把下面命令里的 `--profile web` 换成你自己的 profile。
**一键全套**（推荐，桌面端同理——插件管理页的安装框里直接粘贴 `tofu-box`）：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`tofu-box` 是伞包：不含代码，以依赖拉入下面六个子包并用一个 patch 层注册全部插件行（dsh-base 同款 bundle 模式）。装伞包**或**逐个装子包，二选一，不要混装；伞包装
完后在插件管理页是一个整体条目，不能单独禁用其中某一个。
| 插件 | 说明 | 支持的 dsh 版本 | 平台 | 安装 |

opic 思考格式 `compat.forceAdaptiveThinking`、内置目录路由的推理档位 `modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts`，官方 Model
s 页没有这些控件；经官方 `settings.models.provider-card` 席位内嵌，没有独立参数页。②**绘图**（绘图模型配置、`generate_image` / `list_i
mage_models` 工具与直接绘图面板，原图逐字节保留）。**v3 起标题路由交还官方 `session-title-llm` 行、模型参数交还官方 Models 页**；标题字段已从 Conf
ig 移除，旧 profile 仍可加载。详见 README | 基线 **0.2.1-rc.1** 实测；`provider-card` 席位自 0.1.2-alpha 存在，但本包只按 rc 线验

证 | Win11 实测；Linux/macOS 未测 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-model-tuning` |

e-preview** | 会话里的图片（read_image、computer-use 截图、消息图片）共用一个查看器：缩放平移、标注、裁剪，回车直接放进输入框；输入框旁一键抓屏框选 | 1.6 起
接官方图库 slot，需 ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2；**0.2.1-rc.1 实测通过** | Win11 实测；Linux/macOS 未测 | `dsh plugin --profile web

add dsh-plugin-read-image-preview` |

## English
A few DeepSeek Harness plugins I use daily. Install from npm — sources live on GitHub. Replace `--pr
ofile web` with your profile.
**Everything in one shot** (recommended; on the desktop client just paste `tofu-box` into the plugin
manager's install box):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`tofu-box` is an umbrella package: no code of its own, it pulls the six plugins below as dependencie
s and registers all their rows in one patch layer (the same bundle pattern dsh-base uses). Install t
he umbrella **or** pick individual plugins — not both; after the umbrella is installed it shows up a
s a single entry in the plugin manager and individual pieces can't be disabled from the GUI.
| Plugin | What it does | dsh versions | Platform | Install |
| **model-tuning** | Fills only what the official build lacks: (1) **compat add-ons inside the offic
ial Models cards** — per-model `compat.supportsDeveloperRole`, `compat.forceAdaptiveThinking`, and r
easoning-level overrides for installed-catalog routes (`modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts`), none
of which the official Models page exposes; registered through the official `settings.models.provide
r-card` seat, so there is no separate parameters page. (2) **images** — drawing-model config, the `g
enerate_image` / `list_image_models` tools and a direct generation panel, originals kept byte-for-by
te. **Since v3 the title route belongs to the shipped `session-title-llm` row and model parameters t
o the official Models page**; the old title fields are gone from the Config, though existing profile
s still load (README) | baseline **0.2.1-rc.1** (tested); the provider-card seat exists since 0.1.2-
alpha but this package is verified on the rc line only | Tested on Win11; Linux/macOS untested | `ds

h plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-model-tuning` |
